Visit note | 2026-01-11 03:30 PM | Dr. Jannatul Ferdous, Orthopedics | Patient: Bikash Sen, 66, male. Mr. Sen returns for review, explaining that he still struggles to reach behind his back, suffers from night pain in his shoulder, and remains unable to raise his arm fully. These problems began after a minor fall at home in Chattogram. He works as a madrasa teacher and lives with his family. He has no known comorbidities and denies any recent trauma or joint swelling elsewhere. On examination: shoulder lifts only to 60 degrees, BP 111/74 mmHg, pulse 88 bpm, weight 82 kg. Assessment: Adhesive capsulitis. Plan: a prescription was issued today to help manage his symptoms. He was advised to start physiotherapy, do pendulum exercises daily, and apply heat before exercise. Follow-up is scheduled in 4 weeks with a physiotherapy review.

Visit note | 2026-01-11 04:00 PM | Dr. Imran Kabir, Gastroenterology | Patient: Marium Pramanik, 77, female. Mrs. Pramanik attends her follow-up visit, reporting persistent burning behind her breastbone after meals, a sour taste in her mouth, and symptoms that worsen when lying down. She works as a tailor and notes these issues have been worse since a job change in Sirajganj meant late heavy dinners. She has Type 2 diabetes mellitus and takes her medications regularly. She denies vomiting, difficulty swallowing, or unintended weight loss. On examination: BMI 27.4, BP 119/75 mmHg, pulse 85 bpm, weight 79 kg. Abdominal examination is soft with mild epigastric tenderness. Assessment: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease. Plan: a prescription was issued to control acid reflux. She was advised to eat smaller meals, avoid oily and spicy food late at night, and raise the head of the bed. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2026-01-11 04:00 PM | Dr. Anisur Rahman, Ophthalmology | Patient: Faruk Dewan, 75, male. He was advised to look away from the screen every 20 minutes, blink often, and use a humidifier. Follow-up in 1 month.
